prompt: Refine the matte materials of this exact kitchen sprite. Preserve layout, outline, camera, all inventory, unlit handles and dark diffusers. Target metal only: pot and lid, ladle/spatula/skimmer/frying pan, sink/faucet, metal utensil cup, shelf tins and hood. Replace narrow white/silver specular streaks with broad low-contrast medium-gray diffuse shading. Pot should look like dull seasoned aluminum, faucet matte brushed gray, tools dull steel. No bright white rim lines or glossy cylindrical light stripes. Keep cream cabinet faces and pale bowls their current brightness; do not globally darken/desaturate. Preserve glass pantry contents, plant, jars, labels, towel and food detail. No new grime, scratches, glow, steam, or lights. Same complete asset on uniform pure white background.
